A1.justification: Both PDFs describe NeCGS and contain complete, readable main text and six supplementary pages. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original geometry-compression experiments, timing measurements, ablations, and qualitative reconstructions in Section 4 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons, ablations, and supplementary reconstructions.

M1.justification: TSDF-Def, deformable marching cubes, the quantization-aware auto-decoder, losses, Huffman coding, and embedding optimization for newly added shapes are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate AMA, DT4D, Thingi10K, and Mixed, and retain the same dynamic scenario involving additions to a compressed geometry set.

E2.justification: Figures 4–5 and 15 retain GPCC, VPCC, PCGCv2, Draco, and QuantDeepSDF. Table 1 retains the same four codec baselines; no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Sample counts, shape normalization, optimization budgets, and CD/NC/F-score evaluation remain unchanged, including the supplementary protocol sampling 100,000 points per shape.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same representation and regularization comparisons, auto-encoder comparison, SSIM ablation, resolution analysis, and dynamic-scenario demonstration.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3, rate-distortion curves, and main and supplementary reconstructions retain the same results. For example, Table 1 reports 10.01 hours compression and 98.95 milliseconds decompression for NeCGS in both versions.

T1.justification: The TSDF-Def definition and mathematical formulations in Equations (1)–(11), including supplementary quantization, reconstruction losses, and metric definitions, are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, detailed-geometry preservation, compression up to approximately 900 times, and dynamic-scenario claims.

C2.justification: Both retain the same mechanism explanations, attribution of weaker Thingi10K/Mixed performance to shape diversity, and discussion of compression-time costs versus decompression efficiency for offline use.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, architecture and baseline implementation details, supplementary instructions, and code-access information are unchanged. The PDFs retain identical external-link targets.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to prior geometry representation and compression methods are unchanged. Bibliography back-reference page numbers change only with repagination.

P1.justification: v3 adds Weiyao Lin, with affiliation and contact details, and updates the arXiv version/date stamps. Body wording and section order are retained.

P2.justification: The author block changes from one row to two, with subsequent content reflow. Table 2 moves from page 7 to page 8, and Figure 11 switches columns on page 8; figure content, captions, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added author and layout reflow preserve the scientific exposition, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and supplementary content. These limited presentation changes produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
